action_items: No defects found in iter462 INFORM Act feature. Ship it.
critical_code_review_comments: inform_act.py compute_rolling_stats (L56-114): correctly deduplicates via seen set(session_id) between db.transactions and db.payment_transactions, and lazily builds prod_map only if the fallback iteration finds work — nice perf tradeoff. Uses max(1, int(qty or 1)) to defend against weird payloads.

inform_act.py _masked_submission (L252-259): explicit allowlist of returnable fields — tax_id and tax_id_hash are absent from the whitelist so they can NEVER leak to any endpoint that goes through _maker_view. Tested and confirmed in test_valid_submit_masks_tax_id + test_admin_get_ok. Correct PII posture.

inform_act.py submit endpoint (L317-354): raw tax_id is stripped to digits, only last-4 + SHA-256 hash of the digits stored; the pydantic model dump excludes tax_id (L338 `req.model_dump(exclude={"tax_id"})`). Solid — full number is unrecoverable from DB.

inform_act.py seller_disclosure (L499-521): individual sellers get PARTIAL address (state+country only) as the Act permits — business sellers get full commercial address. This matches statutory language (§45f(b)(2)(A)(ii)(II)). Correct legal implementation.

inform_act.py reinstate endpoint (L482-495): three-way state derivation — verified_at → verified; else submission → pending; else → collection_required with fresh deadline. Handles all lifecycle branches without leaving a shop in a dangling state. Nice.

run_inform_scan (L152-248): sends REAL emails via _email (maker) + _email_ops (ops). No dry-run flag or DRY_RUN env guard for staging/preview — if a preview pod ever gets real Mailgun creds AND real transaction data, every scan spams the ops inbox. Consider adding an env-gated DRY_RUN mode or making _email a no-op when EMAIL_PROVIDER='off'.

InformActCard.jsx: correctly hides itself when status='monitoring' (L68 `if (!state || state.status === 'monitoring') return null;`) so non-flagged makers never see the compliance UI — good UX. StatusBadge maps every status to color-coded pill (data-testid='inform-act-status').

InformActTab.jsx Row.act (L55-66): swallows detail from failed calls with a toast — reasonable, but for HTTP 5xx a distinct 'server error, ops paged' path would help admins distinguish 'my note is too short' from 'backend crashed'. Non-blocking.

MakerDetail.jsx SellerDisclosure: fetches the public /seller-disclosure endpoint and silently no-renders on 404 — clean pattern for optional data. Also correctly walks vanity resolution via the same URL path since the endpoint accepts custom_url too (verified by ironoak2 test).

rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Every review-request bullet passed. The masking design (allowlist-based _masked_submission + model_dump exclude of tax_id + SHA-256 hash storage) is exactly right: the raw tax ID is truly unrecoverable from DB or any API response. The lifecycle state machine (monitoring → collection_required → pending_verification → verified → [suspended|collection_required]) has clean transitions with no dangling states, and reinstate correctly derives the target state from submission+verified_at markers. Public disclosure follows §45f(b)(2) literally — individuals get state+country partial, businesses get full commercial address.
